title: Update notice
summary: A newer version of the app is online while the page is open: one status row, a Reload action, a dismiss that holds for that version.

try.label: Reach the last control of a long screen

purpose: AppShell update={{ available, version, onReload }}: the kit's own notice at the foot of the screen column (above the phone's tab bar), in the shell's words (English or French), never covering the last control of a long screen, dismissed for the version it names.

fixture.usage: <AppShell layout="screen" title="Harbor Studio" nav={nav} route={route} update={{ available, version, onReload }} />

notes: The notice is a status row in the flow, not an overlay: the screen above it shrinks, so the last control of a long screen stays reachable and is never under the notice. It takes no focus. Reload and the dismiss are 44 px on a phone. A dismiss holds for the version named; another version shows it again.

steps.name: setUpdate
steps.say: The app learns that a newer version is online
steps.expect: A status row appears above the tab bar, with Reload and a dismiss; the focus does not move.
The host's reload handler runs once.
The notice goes and the screen takes its room back.

steps.name: setUpdate
steps.say: The same version is announced again
steps.expect: A dismiss holds for the version it was made on: nothing comes back.

steps.name: newVersion
steps.expect: The notice shows again for the later version.

flows.name: Reach the last control of a long screen

steps.say: Scroll to the end of the journal
steps.expect: The last button ends above the notice, not under it.
